prose_passages.classification: Editorial footnote and its numeral, not epic verse.
prose_passages.en: 1. There is no such heading in the original.

translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from extraction and all20PDFpageimages. No acquired prior English translation or translation service used. Selected primary dictionaries consulted; provisional senses/syntax noted per ID. No whole unidentified utterance or noun passed off as English. Proper names and identified cultural terms retained where appropriate. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l001: Continues praise of Talas from545:l042. Rhetorical negative questions retained throughout, not treated as actual objections to settlement.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l004: Kumys by day/girls by night retained as narrator’s sensual pastoral praise; no ages or further acts invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l006: кулан wild ass as printed, unusually mounted here; not silently changed to a domestic horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l008: багалак variant of абалак: horn playing-piece used to strike knucklebones in ordo. Manas encyclopedia gives near-exact formula. “Horn pieces” corrects overly broad knucklebones draft. Ordo game distinct from court sense at021/029.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l010: таң жарылган dawn-breaking delight: image retained; exact idiomatic intensity provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l018: Literal these are not found: contextually their like hard to find, not a claim the described plants are absent.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l019: оромпой one-legged hopping/kicking game, confirmed by Yudakhin and2015 dictionary; no whole unidentified name substituted for English.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l023: көйкашка distinguished men, not a separate named tribe.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l027: кызык салуу here havoc/trouble for opponents, not innocent amusement; hostile-clash context.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l032: Keng-Kol and Talas names retained; tamarisk describes vegetation, not another person.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l039: төрт түлүк traditional four livestock classes; no invented inventory.
notes.manas-2010:p0546:b001:l042: таман sole/foot used for ordo ground measure. Forty paces provisional; no modern metric conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l001: сары журт old/abandoned campsite, not a named Yellow Nation.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l004: кысыр эмди yearlings still nursing a mare not foaling that season; barren does not mean incapable of lactation.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l005: Two hundred yearlings staked; repeated betting/match activity, not spear combat.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l008: Lynx and marten both retained in compressed fur-cap description; how the two furs are combined not specified.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l010: кол артып extending a hand toward people; exact generosity/gesture nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l019: укурук кайыр- catching-pole resistance idiom retained with literal object, signaling none opposed him.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l026: At least sixty mares slaughtered for household/feast as source states; no annual rate inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l033: кара арак strong/plain distilled spirits; literal black retained in note rather than assuming color of drink.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l035: көөкөр leather flask. Printed бир арак compressed/odd; general spirits-in-flask reading provisional, not a specified modern volume.
notes.manas-2010:p0547:b001:l036: жанаяк handled/travel wooden cup per2015 dictionary; not only a tobacco mortar, its other common sense.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b001:l002: дүмпүлдөк Yudakhin calls game wolves and sheep; explanatory dictionaries describe blanket-protected players struck by opponents and protected by a guard. Next two verse rows retain mock beating.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b001:l005: Kaynar spring-eye; capitalization permits place-name, while кайнар itself means spring/source. No modern geolocation asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b001:l006: чынар plane tree, not general pine.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b001:l008: Newly ruler likely Jakyp in subsequent subject; clause attachment to Manas remains possible. Raw order preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b001:l014: бай rendered Wealthy as earlier epithet contrasted with Khan at015.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b001:l019: күн jealousy, not sun/day in livestock possessiveness context.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b003:l001: багалак playing the ordo/knucklebones game by metonymy, as distinguished from specific horn playing-piece546:l008.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b003:l004: Jakyp’s wish for son’s death retained; no actual death occurs here.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b003:l007: Burial after imagined death; source pronoun omitted, Manas supplied as contextually addressed son.
notes.manas-2010:p0548:b003:l014: Wild-ass phrase continues across page boundary into549:l001. It is verse, not heading/footer.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l001: куубас “cannot/will not chase” continues wild asses; sound-play with куу баш childless/barren head at003 retained semantically, not recreated phonetically.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l004: Drink stones instead of spirits: angry impossible command, not literal health advice or an omitted curse.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l005: азар түмөн huge-number formula retained without a precise modern livestock total.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l009: чык broth/gravy, not dew in feast context.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l016: Yudakhin кээмди чыгарды = paid me back; vengeance/retribution idiom with far-off wrong.2015/1969 entry cites close Semetey formula about taking mares. Earlier resentment wording revised.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l023: Repeated кээ retribution formula retained separately; see016.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l027: Printed dirt/cannot-touch-by-hand clause remains semantically awkward. Literal relative modifier retained; exact idiom and relation to valued/gentle livestock028 provisional. No raw emendation to dirty hands.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l028: ыймандуу literally faithful/morally good, extended affectionately to gentle livestock; not a statement of animal religious observance.
notes.manas-2010:p0549:b001:l034: түптүз entirety of laughter/joy; exact colloquial intensifier provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0550:b001:l001: Door-sized white teeth, epic bodily hyperbole preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0550:b001:l016: Four corners of the circle/world literal cosmographic figure; not geometrically corrected.
notes.manas-2010:p0550:b001:l018: Five corners of Medina as printed; no harmonization to four or historical city plan.
notes.manas-2010:p0550:b001:l023: As-if-unborn sinking image; туна exact verbal nuance provisional, not missing English utterance.
notes.manas-2010:p0550:b001:l026: Eighteen thousand worlds conventional cosmic multitude, explicit number retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0550:b001:l028: Zhelpinish and Zhet-Kayt retained as printed remote-land designations; no modern identification forced.
notes.manas-2010:p0550:b001:l035: Printed Алам contextual strength алым/алам; weakness refers to needing companionship rather than denial of prior prowess. Exact form provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0550:b001:l037: эгиз twin used for matching companion, not a newly disclosed biological twin.
notes.manas-2010:p0551:b001:l005: Twelve-member complete-body formula preserved, not twelve modern anatomical limbs.
notes.manas-2010:p0551:b001:l009: Prayer addresses God while quoting father’s reproach; pronouns clarified without substituting speakers.
notes.manas-2010:p0551:b001:l013: Restored source ordering of heard/seen modifier013 and warriors014 after drafting; no two-ID reversal remains.
notes.manas-2010:p0551:b001:l019: Remote hole metaphor for insatiability kept; possible coarse allusion not expanded into explicit anatomy.
notes.manas-2010:p0551:b001:l025: дилде gold coins, no unsupported denomination or value conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0551:b001:l029: үч убак three times/periods, read three times a day; exact routine not specified.
notes.manas-2010:p0551:b001:l033: Eight missing paternal kinsmen as printed. Not harmonized with later eight sons of Karakan including Jakyp.
notes.manas-2010:p0551:b001:l039: Death shared, life together: companionship oath rather than actual death.
notes.manas-2010:p0552:b001:l003: Kozhosan invoked protective figure; no inferred identity with the later old man.
notes.manas-2010:p0552:b001:l009: Shay protective patron, head of forty chiltens; consistent with shared glossary, not equipment or ordinary human father.
notes.manas-2010:p0552:b001:l013: Kara-Buura and Chatkal geographic list retained; precise route chronology not reconstructed.
notes.manas-2010:p0552:b001:l018: Bek-Zhayloo at head of Besh-Tash; places retained as source names.
notes.manas-2010:p0552:b001:l025: White-bearded dervish not named immediately; subsequent self-identification retained at its actual rows.
notes.manas-2010:p0552:b001:l034: Six lions, of whom Manas youngest; no roster invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0552:b001:l036: I, old/aged, with beyond-measure intensifier; attachment of артыгынча across036–037 provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0552:b001:l041: Tügöl ancestor-name; do not silently identify with Tümön553:l005.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l001: Second-person place where you spent a night as printed, despite nearby ancestral narration. No pronoun emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l003: Saint(s) protects ancestor: unmarked олуя number not secure; collective saints used.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l005: Tümön, Sanchy, Böyön, Chayan, Ogoy succession preserved row by row; not reconciled with other genealogies.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l011: Negative universal passage011–014: no land unvisited/no people unconquered. Literal structure could otherwise sound like destroying unvisited lands; scope uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l015: Lop river form preserved; Lob variant appears561:l022. Same geographic identification probable but not asserted as verified.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l020: Coveting/envious enemies; object what was his supplied contextually, exact motive unspecified.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l032: Hundred steeds tied for each heroic man; gift/coercion relation not independently verified.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l035: Not sitting/staring: active hero formula, exact idiomatic nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0553:b001:l037: 037–040 difficult subject linkage: draft reads needy/greedy people whom Ogoy protected as father. Could characterize Ogoy’s own demand/greed; specialist review needed, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0554:b001:l003: Eight sons of Karakan, not reconciled with eight missing paternal kinsmen551/554.
notes.manas-2010:p0554:b001:l008: Steed fragment preserved before exhortation009; no missing verb invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0554:b001:l016: Eighty-four companions explicitly жолдош; no substitution with forty chiltens or eighty-four armor parts.
notes.manas-2010:p0554:b001:l019: Umbilical birth blood literal birthplace formula.
notes.manas-2010:p0554:b001:l025: тигинен straight/upright attack; precise motion provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0554:b001:l026: Ninety mountains and supporting ridge metaphor retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0554:b001:l033: Split lungs and take gall, literal destructive threat; not softened to defeat alone.
notes.manas-2010:p0554:b001:l040: Measure ground in preparation for combat/travel; no numerical distance supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l003: бейбилчек not found in Yudakhin endpoints checked. Primary Kyrgyz anatomy textbooks use it for metacarpal bone; equine context supports cannon bone by anatomical correspondence, but exact traditional equine term remains provisional. тутам handgrip/fist-sized length, corrected from handspan; no centimetres asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l005: согончок heel; тутам handgrip measure, not карыш handspan.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l006: топор Kyrgyz nag/wretched animal, not Russian axe; confirmed Yudakhin.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l011: жол жорго slow pacing gait, as Yudakhin distinguishes from faster gait; not road-place name.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l015: Seventy days/night travel retained, distinct from six months012.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l020: Mane and tail stand for horse’s fighting courage, not literal sentient hair.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l023: аманат entrusted life, religious human-life idiom retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l036: Explicit pig anus comparison retained as derogatory horse assessment; not medical diagnosis.
notes.manas-2010:p0555:b001:l042: жолу болсун dismissive let it go well/on its way; no blessing of a specific route invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0556:b001:l002: колтук forelimb/armpit area rendered shoulders of horse, approximate anatomical English.
notes.manas-2010:p0556:b001:l015: Baabedin shrine named as in source; historical saint identification not independently established here.
notes.manas-2010:p0556:b001:l018: Adam and Eve explicitly named in shrine legend; no claim of historical location.
notes.manas-2010:p0556:b001:l026: кош camp/paired partnership amid subsequent agricultural work; camp adopted, not yet the actual two oxen.
notes.manas-2010:p0556:b001:l030: Ak-Talaa retained distinct in spelling from Boz-Talaa despite apparently linked place; no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0556:b001:l039: амыз = намыс honor/shame per Yudakhin; two parallel prohibitions retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0556:b001:l041: Splitting black hair exactly: fairness/equal partnership idiom; literal image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0557:b001:l010: күлдөй шай smooth as spread ashes, contextual making father content; exact simile note rather than misread flower күл/гүл.
notes.manas-2010:p0557:b001:l015: түрүлгөн folded/swollen/imposing wealthy state, exact epithet provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0557:b001:l016: көргөнү father’s recognition/gratitude, inferred from reproach context; literal what father saw could also be intended.
notes.manas-2010:p0557:b001:l025: Explicit being from unseen realm, not an invented natural explanation of old man’s arrival.
notes.manas-2010:p0557:b001:l038: шамыяны = шамыян yoke-pin, confirmed Yudakhin and explanatory dictionary with Manas plowing example.
notes.manas-2010:p0557:b001:l041: буурсун wooden plow, no modern machinery.
notes.manas-2010:p0558:b001:l009: Oxen vanish, source supernatural action retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0558:b001:l020: Printed Берен калган: ready reading tentatively connects with Белен кылып024. Possible textual defect/variant, not silently corrected in raw extraction.
notes.manas-2010:p0558:b001:l024: Harvest ready during sleep, despite six/seven-month words at040; miracle/time discrepancy not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p0558:b001:l031: Printed кир сөздү. кир can denote mental sorrow/trouble per Yudakhin, supporting troubling word. Exact collocation remains unusual; no silent replacement by бир.
notes.manas-2010:p0558:b001:l040: Both six and seven months retained, not reduced to one duration.
notes.manas-2010:p0559:b001:l012: Printed боз болдук, not дос болдук. Gray-together literal provisional reading, potentially a source defect before дос at014; no silently emended friendship line.
notes.manas-2010:p0559:b001:l014: кыяматтык eternal/to Judgment Day friendship, not just ordinary companionship.
notes.manas-2010:p0559:b001:l015: Chewing wheat flour as alliance/oath act retained literally.
notes.manas-2010:p0559:b001:l016: Third-person named him/you Lion, subject not explicit here; English he not expanded to a new named speaker.
notes.manas-2010:p0559:b001:l026: дары-мын remedy for people; not confused with darым noun incantation, though healer identity could support related resonance.
notes.manas-2010:p0559:b001:l030: Baabedin’s eye as printed көзүмүн; unusual self-identification retained rather than changed to өзүмүн like032.
notes.manas-2010:p0559:b001:l034: Yudakhin зайыр акы = unquestioned rightful entitlement; chеке тер sweat of brow. English rightful earnings encompasses confirmed phrase; no unidentified transliteration retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0559:b001:l040: буудан extended as praise of khan, fleet-footed, rather than a second literal horse in subject position.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l002: Printed farmer’s word; voice renders claim of representing cultivator, not silent word→self emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l004: Babadyykan name retained; also Baabedin559, source identifications not harmonized into one spelling. English spelling normalized from provisional Babadyikan.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l008: Earlier old man explicitly reported, not removed to force single supernatural identity.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l014: Lacked a horse = lacked suitable warhorse; gray mount explicitly criticized555, not absent from story.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l019: азгырып entice/lure retained; old man explains benign purpose, not omitted as morally awkward.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l021: Steed beneath me as printed despite later Karacha ownership account; narrative perspectives not reconciled.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l022: адал honest/lawful earnings for purchase, central reason for growing crop.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l026: Not one round grain, no division/withholding invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l034: Undo one hobble, figurative easing Manas’s constraint; source pronoun preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0560:b001:l038: айлана Godward devotion; exact idiom of devotion/affection provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0561:b001:l005: Six years before birth, as printed, not seven-year prophecy elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0561:b001:l013: Six years waiting, distinct from six-month crop partnership.
notes.manas-2010:p0561:b001:l019: Old Turpan, Barbar and Lob geography retained without modern coordinate identification.
notes.manas-2010:p0561:b001:l024: lower reaches/side positional phrase; exact antecedent river/desert remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0561:b001:l029: No sons, many daughters; эркеги human offspring here, not no stallions in herd.
notes.manas-2010:p0561:b001:l034: күлдөй жөнөө smooth-running affairs, literal ashes simile retained; no unsupported flower emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0561:b001:l037: Mare gives birth; subject changes to foal at038–042.
notes.manas-2010:p0561:b001:l042: Thousand leaps over mother explicitly retained as miraculous birth account.
notes.manas-2010:p0562:b001:l001: көзү ачык clear-sighted/clairvoyant horse judges; not modern veterinary examination.
notes.manas-2010:p0562:b001:l004: No sense in owner who emerges: deliberately awkward printed paradox, possibly criticizing current owner rather than destined hero. No silent emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0562:b001:l011: Threat of transformation on Judgment Day retained, not narrated completed event.
notes.manas-2010:p0562:b001:l020: асый adult age-count begins with fifth year=one asyy; sixty adult-count years retained without asserting sixty chronological years. Hyperbolic longevity.
notes.manas-2010:p0562:b001:l022: чу horse-driving exclamation translated Go, not unidentified utterance.
notes.manas-2010:p0562:b001:l029: кара байыр казанат hardy/noble warhorse; not equated with a modern standardized breed.
notes.manas-2010:p0562:b001:l031: дат destined time/appropriate stature contextually; exact дат sense provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0562:b001:l040: карыпчы ordinarily human armguard. Source uses it in horse-covering formula; broader protective armor rendered, with odd equipment extension explicitly noted.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l001: Dark of moon, not lunar surface.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l006: аркалуу backed/supported, supernatural patronage in miraculous horse context; strong-backed also possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l008: Stranger asks for horse: destined owner distinct from present keeper, no invented named purchaser.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l017: окто = нокто halter, verified Yudakhin; not loading ammunition. Repeated564:l022,l035 retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l019: Open fortune and sell, metaphor retained; no new payment amount.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l026: Dust makes earth invisible in fighting; split-earth image literal.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l030: Bulky/dangling covering, exact коржоктотуп nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l034: чет border/frontier or edge of battle; frontier adopted, exact scope uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l036: кынап fit/equip, here saddle and ride; not erase repetition of ride formulas.
notes.manas-2010:p0563:b001:l041: Duldul named exemplary sacred steed used as epithet/comparison, not a newly introduced literal horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0564:b001:l007: Source row ordering restored: forging actions007, smiths’ steel008; no swapped source IDs.
notes.manas-2010:p0564:b001:l009: чаткаяк area between legs, not cheek/jaw.
notes.manas-2010:p0564:b001:l010: табылгы woody meadowsweet shrub; not necessarily soft meadow flowers.
notes.manas-2010:p0564:b001:l012: Forty rope-length dungeon depth retained, no metric conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0564:b001:l027: асый reaches fifth year/adulthood per dictionary; English maturity, precise age explained here.
notes.manas-2010:p0564:b001:l031: талак renunciation/divorce metaphor, horse abandoning herd; not a human marriage event.
notes.manas-2010:p0564:b001:l038: бейле take heed/consider, exact unusual imperative provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0565:b001:l003: Gift yields property; authorized to accept without timidity, not theft or new purchase price.
notes.manas-2010:p0565:b001:l013: көмүркөй coffer/storage container, not coal mine.
notes.manas-2010:p0565:b001:l023: каран intensifier/affective epithet rendered wondrous; may have darker curse shade.
notes.manas-2010:p0565:b001:l024: Horse/master born together explicitly retained, no independent chronology claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0565:b001:l027: союлгур literal may it be slaughtered, affective imprecation despite advice not to slaughter; not harmonized away.
notes.manas-2010:p0565:b001:l035: Not your property: judges distinguish fated master and present keeper; no modern legal conclusion.
notes.manas-2010:p0565:b001:l039: каран калган pity/curse epithet, here wretched; source paradox of precious yet cursed horse preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0565:b001:l042: Horse judge returns home; closes reported speech, whereas larger Babadyykan conversation continues beyond range.

transcription_check.scope: All twenty PDF pages rendered at1600pixels and visually inspected in five groups of four.836display rows accounted for:833verse rows,1centered editorial heading,1footnote numeral and1editorial prose footnote.548has35verse rows; other19pages42each. Raw source unchanged; digital witness check only, no manuscript collation.

alignment_check.method: All833Kyrgyz/English pairs read after drafting in five four-page groups; explicit ordered IDs and page counts checked. Reversed modifiers restored to source order; dictionaries checked for game pieces, yoke-pins, halter, rightful earnings and horse-age measure. Same-agent audit, no independent specialist review.
